name: Dew Drop Hydrating Serum
shortDescription: A lightweight boost of hydration for a fresh, dewy glow.
description: Make hydration your daily ritual. This silky serum combines hyaluronic acid and soothing botanical extracts to leave skin feeling soft and refreshed. Apply two to three drops to clean skin before moisturiser. 30 ml.

name: Everyday Gentle Cleanser
shortDescription: A soft, comforting cleanse that keeps your skin balanced.
description: Wash the day away with a gentle, non-stripping cleanser. Massage onto damp skin, rinse with lukewarm water, and follow with your favourite serum. Suitable for your morning and evening routine. 150 ml.

name: Silk Finish Hair Oil
shortDescription: Smooth flyaways and bring a little shine to every day.
description: A nourishing finishing oil for soft, glossy lengths. Warm a small amount between your palms and smooth through the ends of damp or dry hair. A little goes a long way. 50 ml.

name: Rose & Oat Body Lotion
shortDescription: Velvety moisture with a delicate rose finish.
description: Turn your post-shower routine into a moment of calm. This rich lotion blends oat extract with a soft rose fragrance. Massage onto clean skin whenever it needs a little extra comfort. 250 ml.

name: Rose Quartz Face Roller
shortDescription: A cooling companion for your morning skincare ritual.
description: Take a quiet minute for yourself with a smooth rose quartz roller. Gently roll outwards over clean skin after applying your serum. Clean with a soft damp cloth after use; store somewhere cool and dry.

name: The Weekend Ritual Set
shortDescription: Three lovely essentials for a slower Sunday.
description: A thoughtfully curated set containing a gentle cleanser, hydrating serum, and body lotion in travel-friendly sizes. Presented in a reusable cotton pouch. A lovely gift for someone who deserves a pause.

name: Cloud Soft Hair Mask
shortDescription: An extra dose of care for tired, dry lengths.
description: Give your hair a weekly moment of care with a creamy conditioning mask. Apply to clean, damp lengths, leave for five to ten minutes, then rinse thoroughly. 200 ml.

name: Calm Night Face Cream
shortDescription: A comforting final step for your evening routine.
description: A rich evening moisturiser with squalane and oat extract. Apply a small amount to clean skin after your serum, and let your night-time ritual be a little more restful. 50 ml.

name: Citrus Morning Body Wash
shortDescription: A fresh start, with a gentle citrus-scented lather.
description: Refresh your shower routine with a soft body wash and bright citrus fragrance. Lather onto damp skin and rinse well. Follow with body lotion for a smooth finish. 300 ml.

name: Soft Touch Makeup Brushes
shortDescription: Five everyday brushes in a handy cotton pouch.
description: A versatile set of five soft synthetic brushes for your everyday makeup routine. Includes powder, blush, blending, crease, and detail brushes. Wash gently and air dry flat.

name: Little Moments Travel Kit
shortDescription: Your favourite rituals, ready for a weekend away.
description: A compact collection of cleanser, hair oil, and body lotion in travel sizes. Packed in a reusable zip pouch for an easy, thoughtful travel companion.

name: Nourish & Shine Shampoo
shortDescription: Gentle cleansing for soft, beautifully cared-for hair.
description: A daily shampoo that gently cleanses without weighing hair down. Massage into wet hair, rinse thoroughly, and follow with conditioner. 250 ml.

name: Golden Hour Hand Cream
shortDescription: A little comfort for hands, wherever the day takes you.
description: A pocket-sized hand cream with shea butter and a warm botanical fragrance. Massage into hands as needed. 40 ml.

name: Winter Comfort Collection
shortDescription: A cosy collection of seasonal self-care favourites.
description: A limited-edition collection of rich body lotion, nourishing hand cream, and gentle cleanser. Launching soon.
